# districts-sentinel

Row count of the school districts DB; add or remove the sentinel row that stops a 210 MB download.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--db` | path | no | `misc/schoolDistricts/data/districts.sqlite` | Districts SQLite database |
| `--action` | str | no | `status` | status reads; add inserts the sentinel row; remove deletes it |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run districts-sentinel
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys action, rows, sentinel.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/districts-sentinel.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
